title: org.openvpi.otter.analysis.Note Level 1 exports
description: What a note transcription contribution declares about itself: the audio format a host must prepare, the languages it distinguishes, whether it can be conditioned on known notes, and the knobs it honors. The syntax belongs to the interface and level, not to a variant.

sampleRate.description: Input sample rate in hertz. The host resamples to this; the module never does.

channelCount.description: Input channel count. More channels than this are averaged down by the module, fewer are refused.

maxSegmentDuration.description: Longest span accepted in one execution, in seconds. Absent means no limit. A hard constraint: the host slices to stay under it.

languages.description: Language identifiers this module distinguishes. Absent or empty means it does not distinguish.

supportsKnownNotes.description: Whether the module reads knownNotes and keeps their boundaries.

knobs.description: The knobs this module honors. A knob that is absent is ignored when a caller supplies it.
